spec: DECISIONS.md Host Globals: operations that read host inputs require capabilities, uniformly in all .vibe. Date local-zone operations are Clock reads even when computing a write.

cases.name: unknown parse input
cases.body: function parse(text: string): number { return Date.parse(text) }; return [String(parse('2025-01-01'))]

cases.name: unknown constructor input
cases.body: function date(text: string): number { return new Date(text).getTime() }; return [String(date('2025-01-01'))]

cases.name: cast cannot fabricate an absolute string
const cast cannot fabricate a numeric instant
cases.body: const input = '2025-01-01T00:00:00' as unknown as number; return [String(new Date(input).getTime())]

cases.name: detached unknown parse
cases.body: const parse = Date.parse; function invoke(text: string): number { return parse(text) }; return [String(invoke('2025-01-01'))]

cases.name: destructured unknown parse
cases.body: const { parse } = Date; function invoke(text: string): number { return parse(text) }; return [String(invoke('2025-01-01'))]

cases.name: numeric instant
cases.body: function stamp(n: number): number { return new Date(n).getTime() }; return [String(stamp(0))]

cases.name: expanded year and end of day
UTC construction and mutation
cases.body: return [String(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1)), String(new Date(0).setUTCHours(12)), String(new Date(0).setUTCMinutes(12)), String(new Date(0).setUTCSeconds(12)), String(new Date(0).setUTCMilliseconds(12)), String(new Date(0).setTime(1000))]

cases.name: constant parse aliases
cases.body: const { ['parse']: parse } = Date; const alias = parse; const instant = '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z'; return [String(alias(instant))]

cases.name: lexical Date shadow
cases.body: class Date { static parse(text: string) { return text.length }; setHours(n: number) { return n } }; return [String(Date.parse('local')), String(new Date().setHours(12))]
